description: §42.4 statement 10: the arms of a ternary that is the condition's value (or an operand of its `!` / `&&` / `||`) are inside the condition — an unresolved arm or arm operand is E-COND-NOT-BOOLEAN, once per site.
rationale: §42.4 statement 10: "A ternary that IS the condition's value, or an operand in its `!` / `&&` / `||` chain, is inside the condition: each arm is that value when taken … `if (@b ? !g() : @c)`, `if (@b ? (g() && @c) : @c)`, `if (@b ? g() : @c)` and `if ((@b ? g() : @c) && @c)` each report `g()`". Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S460 "a on F2, go" (PA reading: ternary arms of the condition's value are inside the condition).
